svg.title: Bloom calendar
svg.desc: A softly dimensional flower garden for 2025-10-12 to 2026-10-17: one mark per supplied day in seven weekday rows, 130 contributions, longest streak 8 days, current streak 4 days. Sleeping seeds mean no contributions. Taller stems and fuller flowers mean busier days; the four activity levels are the ones reported by GitHub. Weeks run diagonally across the garden.
